blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A updated agreement between the Philippines and Taiwan is expected to create more employment opportunities for qualified Filipino workers, particularly in the hospitality sector, according to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). In a statement on Saturday, the DMW welcomed the signing of a new Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the Manila Economic and Cultural Office (Meco) and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (Teco) on the renewed Special Hiring Program for Taiwan (SHPT). Meco is the Philippines’ de facto embassy in Taiwan in the absence of formal diplomatic ties, with Manila’s adherence to the “one China policy” […]...
